integrity: The complete foundational Hénon article was inspected through full extracted text, with the defining map, inverse, fixed-point formulas, parameter regime, and trapping-region sections also checked visually on the PDF. A full open Senti–Takahasi preprint was inspected for its model definition, invariant-measure setup, main theorem, and structure, with targeted searches for moment and average formulations. The accepted identity was independently reconstructed from invariance, and the general algebra plus the classical radical arithmetic were replayed from the packaged exact checker. No numerical orbit experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for a>0 and 0<b<1; the first-moment identity extends further, but the equilibrium-support rigidity uses this dissipative range.
The theorem constrains compact invariant measures but does not prove existence, uniqueness, physicality, entropy, or Lyapunov properties of a chaotic measure.
The strip-crossing conclusion is measure-theoretic rather than a continuous-path crossing statement.
The expectation identity is algebraically short, so an older differently phrased observation in numerical or periodic-orbit literature could remain unlocated.
The foundational publication date is recorded as February 1976 by a Crossref-derived record; a separate bibliographic record explicitly gives 1 February 1976.
title: Exact stationary fixed-point parabola and strip crossing for the Hénon map
